name: plate-46-swoopy-chute
version_tag: Swoopy Poop Chute for X1/P1P/P1S (third-party, MakerWorld 93198) — purge catcher, timed for plate-45 which is the first two-colour plate and will make a real pile of poops. NOT a mechanism part, so two of our standing settings are deliberately OFF: (1) xy_contour_compensation is 0, NOT -0.06. Our -0.06 exists to make posts and keys print at their mate bore size (#136); a third-party model was drawn for nominal, and shrinking every outer contour 0.06/side would tighten its chassis mounting for no reason. (2) walls 2 and infill 10% instead of 3/25% — the designer's 165g/3.9h figure is at standard settings and this is a hollow box that catches waste, not a part under load. Quiet slicing overrides kept as always. No supports (the designer states none needed). PARTS LIST IS PROVISIONAL: the download may be one STL or several, or a 3mf. Confirm what actually landed in parts/stl/ before composing and fix the list. Position is 'center' rather than a coordinate because the design office has not seen the model's bounding box. | QUIET.
